title: JSON Processing
concept: JSON parsing and generation with xiom.json — serialize XIOM types to JSON and deserialize JSON into strongly-typed XIOM structs.
why: JSON is the universal data interchange format. Every nontrivial program eventually needs to read or write JSON — from config files to REST APIs.
tips: Use #[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)] for automatic JSON mapping — it's fast and type-safe
json::from_str returns Result — always handle parse errors
Pretty-print during development (`to_string_pretty`), compact for production
JSON numbers are lossy for Float64 — use string representation for exact values
common_mistakes: Assuming JSON keys exist — use .get() or handle Option
Forgetting that JSON numbers are always parsed as Float64 if not annotated
Not validating JSON structure before deserializing — malformed input should produce errors, not panics
